My experience with this business was entirely unacceptable and demonstrates a serious lack of professionalism, honesty, and accountability. My vehicle was held for approximately four days, and I was charged nearly $1,700 for a repair that failed to address the issue. Despite a clear agreement to replace a specific part, the shop knowingly reinstalled the same defective component rather than ordering and installing the new one as promised. The original problem remains unresolved, forcing me to incur additional towing and repair expenses a week later.

Furthermore, I was required to sign a “no warranty” form after I asked about warranty— an action that now appears to have been used to shield the business from responsibility for incomplete and negligent work. Such practices are deceptive, unethical, and potentially fraudulent.

I will be pursuing this matter through legal channels to recover the losses incurred and to hold this establishment accountable for its actions. I strongly caution others against doing business here.
